LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING, INTERACTIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and speaking
Topic 1.9: Active Listening, Interactive speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Active Listening, Interactive speaking, part of Listening and speaking in Grade 9 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How do you get key information from texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. name essential facilities found in the locality,

2. look at a map and take note of the various facilities (e.g. school, church, mosques, market, hospital, etc),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. name essential facilities found in the locality,
2. look at a map and take note of the various facilities (e.g. school, church, mosques, market, hospital, etc),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Active Listening, Interactive speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: the learner develops an awareness of their own school and home surroundings when s/he discusses with peers

where the essential facilities in the locality are and how to there.

Values:
Patriotism: the learner demonstrates awareness of the value of loyalty and love for own country when s/he discusses with

peers where the essential facilities in the locality are and how to get there.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Citizenship: the learner develops awareness for love of own country when s/he discusses with peers where the essential

facilities in the locality are and how to get there.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner associates the knowledge on facilities found in their community with content learned in Social studies.
